Must have a degree as a Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) OR a degree as a Medical Doctor (MD) with 2 or more years in integrative medicine practice.

The UCI Susan Samueli Integrative Health Institute (SSIHI) seeks an outstanding individual for a full-time staff position as a physician to work collaboratively with our diverse, interprofessional team to deliver evidence-based integrative healthcare and make a difference in the lives of our patients and our community. The staff physician provides comprehensive integrative medicine services and follow-up visit/conference with patients in the Integrative Medicine program to ensure the highest quality care to patients. Physician with experience in the practice of integrative medicine including the following: Familiarity with specialty lab testing, prescribing supplements, hormones, and IV nutrient therapies, as well as managing complex conditions from an integrative perspective. The physician will provide direct outpatient care, be involved in teaching residents and medical students, as well as participate in scholarly activities.
